name: dlpfc-goals
description: dlPFC goal-conditioned recall MVP (RESEARCH.md §PFC.dlPFC). When --goal <tag> is set, memories whose tags array contains the goal tag get a 1.5x score boost and results are re-sorted. Three untagged 'plan note' entries lead with the query and differ from each other; two memories tagged `auth-rewrite` mention only 'migration'. Without --goal the three plan notes fill top-3. With --goal auth-rewrite the 1.5x boost lifts both tagged entries above every plan note. Recalibrated 2026-09-24 for classic hybrid ranking (physics off by default): the old three near-identical plan notes were diversified out of top-3. Measured on the default path: weakest plan note 1.05 vs strongest tagged 0.93 without --goal; tagged 1.39 vs strongest plan note 1.12 with it.
